provider_requirements.text: Hospital-exemption products are prepared on a non-routine basis to specific quality standards and used in a hospital under the exclusive professional responsibility of a medical practitioner.

residency_travel_notes.text: Hospital-exemption products must be used in a hospital within the same Member State.
